checklist.detail: Tidewatch Wreck provides a visible discovery → reward → return journey.
Claiming the Tidewatch reward raises a persistent visual harbor signal; player-selected harbor construction remains next.

Persistent log, first-voyage cue, notifications, and a dedicated discovery stinger provide clearer feedback.
The wreck includes low-cost animated seabirds, complementing existing reef and shore life.
Discovery Log persists named discoveries and the harbor reward transformation.
Shared first-voyage messaging is released; complete shared harbor roles and controller hardware proof remain.
Harbor prop is bounded, animated without per-frame allocation, and disposal-owned; long-session browser measurement remains required.
Signal lantern, mast, route board, wreck, sail, gull silhouettes, and HUD route cue strengthen the outbound/return composition.
Original discovery stinger and actionable early route copy complement existing responsive/accessible menu work.
